_comment: Masteries listing (DESIGN §1.4): one record per listed patch, chronological. Seeded by tools/import-masteries.js from the research changed-patches.json files; hand-maintained afterwards (re-run the importer with --no-listing).

reason: season-start | change | season-end | season-start+change | season-end+change. source: {ddragon: <build>} (data/sources/masteries/ddragon/<build>.json) or {wiki: <patch>} (data/sources/masteries/wiki/<patch>.json); crossCheck = the DDragon builds the S3 templates of that patch are checked against (M5): V1.0.0.152 3.6.14, V3.13 3.13.24.
textOnly: a season boundary whose payload differs from the previous listed patch in tooltip text only (DESIGN §0 counts it as a boundary with no change; check C2).

changes[].text keeps the research wording; the trailing [..] names the evidence: DD = Data Dragon, WP = wiki patch page, WM = wiki mastery page, RN = Riot patch notes, LC = League Client game data (CommunityDragon).
Labels, ids, era and chrome are not stored here: tools/lib/patches.js computes them (labelFor, idFor, chromeOf).

changes.text: Launch (gold) build; masteries as of the last beta patch V0.9.25.34. Differs from s1-final: Mender's Faith (+75 heal, -10 s Heal CD), Willpower 30 s, Demolisher present, Cripple 25, Improved Rally +20% base magic damage, Reinforce (+9 minion damage while Fortify is up), Haste 8%, Ardor half-then-scaling, Strength of Spirit 0.5/1/1.5% per 5 s, Meditation 1.66/3.33/5, Veteran's Scars 15/30/45/60, Havoc 5% base damage.

Client look (not data): the S1 sheet head (cream pills, Achievements greyed and last, Find Summoner in the tab row) follows the dated live capture of September 2010 (YouTube Yq2BRjZSoX8, 2010-09-11; Apr / Jun 2011 captures agree), the same strip as the S1 rune page; Riot's 2010 press shots show a crimson active pill with Achievements third. V1.0.0.32-V1.0.0.94 (October 2009 - June 2010) reuse it: an evidence gap (css/air-sheet.css section 6).
Mender's Faith: Heal bonus changed to 10 x champion level (10-180) from 75 flat (+10 s cooldown reduction) [medium].
Mender's Faith: now reduces Heal cooldown by 30 s instead of the 10 x level heal bonus [high].
Reinforce: Fortify loses its own splash; Reinforce now makes Fortify give allied turrets 50% splash damage (was +9 minion damage) [low on old text].
Demolisher removed together with the Promote summoner spell (Offense tier 4 keeps only Brute Force) [high].
sources: https://leagueoflegends.fandom.com/wiki/Promote (V1.0.0.63: removed, "Demolisher removed until Promote is reintroduced"; V1.0.0.129 added to SR)
Riot 2010 client screenshot (scratchpad refs/masteries-classic/wb-riot-2010-masteries.jpg): Offense tier 4 holds only Brute Force

changes.text: Willpower: Cleanse cooldown reduction 30 -> 20 s [high].
Cripple: Exhaust armor / magic resist reduction 25 -> 10 [high].
Improved Rally: now 20-70 AP (by level) instead of +20% base magic damage [high value, medium wording].
Haste: Ghost movement speed bonus 8% -> 6% [high].
Ardor: full 1.33/2.66/4% AP and attack speed from level 1 (was half at level 1 scaling to full at 18); tooltip clarified [medium].
Strength of Spirit: 0.5/1/1.5% -> 0.33/0.66/1% of max mana as health regen per 5 s (tooltip moved from per-second to per-5) [high].
Meditation: 1.66/3.33/5 -> 1/2/3 mana regen per 5 s [high].
Veteran's Scars: 15/30/45/60 -> 12/24/36/48 health [high].
Havoc: +4% total physical and magic damage, from +5% base damage [high].

Last Season 1 patch (V1.0.0.129 reworked masteries on 2011-11-15). No value change since V1.0.0.118b; Reinforce tooltip names Garrison (Dominion, V1.0.0.125) [low, text only]. Equals s1-final minus Demolisher.

changes.text: No calculator-relevant mastery change anywhere in V3.6-V3.13: DDragon 3.6.14 -> 3.13.24 is identical apart from one tooltip edit (next note), and the wiki patch pages V3.6-V3.13 have no Masteries section. [DD, WP]

Client text: from V3.12 the Summoner's Insight (S3) Revive line names the bonus Health, '(200 + 20 per level)'; no patch note. V3.12 is not listed, so V3.13 is the first listed patch that shows it (override mo-008); V1.0.0.152 (and links to the unlisted V1.0.0.153-V3.12) keep the line without it. [DD]
Data = DDragon 3.13.24 (Season 3 tree, 56 masteries, 42/37/41 ranks). The diff to the previous listed Season 3 patch (V3.5 or earlier) must come from the wiki-era research; DDragon starts at 3.6.14.
Shown with the V1.0.0.152 templates (desc + rankInfo) plus mo-008, its own data file; the build checks every number against DDragon 3.13.24 (V1.0.0.152 against 3.6.14).

Preseason 4 rework: all 56 Season 3 masteries removed; new 2014 tree of 57 masteries on the 4-wide, 6-tier grid (Offense 20 masteries / 38 ranks, Defense 19 / 34, Utility 18 / 33), 15 prerequisite links (Butcher>Feast, Brute Force>Martial Mastery, Mental Force>Arcane Mastery, Spell Weaving>Blade Weaving, Executioner>Dangerous Game, Block>Unyielding, Tough Skin>Bladed Armor, Veteran's Scars>Juggernaut, Hardiness>Reinforced Armor, Resistance>Evasive, Perseverance>Second Wind, Meditation>Strength of Spirit, Alchemist>Culinary Master, Greed>Scavenger, Wealth>Bandit). [DD, WP]

Launch values that later changed: Martial Mastery +5 AD, Arcane Mastery +8 AP, Perseverance 1/2/3% missing HP per 5 s, Feast 2 HP, Bandit melee +15 gold on takedown, Meditation 1/2/3 MP5 (T1), Expanded Mind 2/3.5/5% mana (T4), Inspiration 5/10 XP (2 ranks), Intelligence item-CDR 4/7/10%, Wanderer 5% MS, Legendary Guardian aura 900 range. [DD, WP, WM]

Live-client bug mirrored by DDragon: the T5 4-rank armor/MR aura (id 4252) is named 'Tenacious' and the T6 15% CC-reduction capstone (4262) 'Legendary Guardian'; Riot fixed the swap in V3.15. [DD, WP V3.15, WM]
DDragon-only name defects fixed in 3.15: 'Runic Shield' (wiki and patch notes: Runic Blessing), 'Veteran Scars'. 'Perseverance ' carries a trailing space in every 2014 build. [DD]

Use 3.14.41: builds 3.14.12-3.14.19 are pre-release (a 'Conjuror' mastery, Fury 1-4%, Scout 'wards and trinkets 10%', Inspiration 7.5/7.5, one-value strings for every rank of Brute Force / Fleet of Foot / Meditation / Veteran Scars, typos 'Doubled-Edged', 'Arcane Masrery', 'Perserverance', null rank strings for Mental Force r2-3, Tenacious r4, Expanded Mind r2-3); 3.14.20 onwards matches the live tree. [DD intra-patch]
Scout: 15% trinket cast range (DDragon 3.14.20+, wiki mastery page); the wiki V3.14 patch page's 'wards and trinkets 10%' is the pre-release text. [DD, WM]
Martial Mastery +5 -> +4 attack damage. [DD, WP, WM]
Arcane Mastery +8 -> +6 ability power. [DD, WP, WM]
Perseverance 1/2/3% -> 0.7/1.35/2% missing health every 5 s. [DD, WP, WM]

Tenacious / Legendary Guardian name swap fixed: T5 4-rank aura (+1-4 armor, +0.5-2 MR per nearby enemy champion) is now Legendary Guardian, T6 capstone (15% CC duration reduction) is Tenacious. Cells, ranks and values unchanged. [DD (ids 4252/4262 renamed), WP, WM]
Legendary Guardian aura range 900 -> 700. [WP, WM; not in DDragon text]
DDragon data fixes: Runic Shield -> Runic Blessing, Veteran Scars -> Veteran's Scars (no gameplay change). [DD]
Tooltip-only: Blade Weaving dropped 'This cannot trigger more than once a second'; Meditation 'per 5' -> 'per 5 seconds'; Tough Skin 'effect' -> 'affect'. [DD]
Perseverance 0.7/1.35/2% -> 0.35/0.675/1% missing health every 5 s. [DD, WP, WM]
Tooltip-only: Reinforced Armor 'damage taken by critical strikes' -> 'from critical strikes'. [DD]
Feast on-kill heal 2 -> 3 health (mana 1 unchanged). [DD, WP, WM]
Scavenger range 900 -> 1100. [WP, WM; DDragon text has no range]

Dangerous Game tooltip now 'Champion kills and assists restore 5% missing Health and Mana' (was 'Killing a champion'); wiki calls it an undocumented tooltip change, the effect already counted assists. [DD, WM]

Also folded into this diff (tooltip-only, not listed): V4.3 Bladed Armor bleed now says 'physical damage' (wiki: physical since V3.14); V4.4 Brute Force / Mental Force per-level figures gained '+' signs. [DD]

No calculator-relevant change since V4.5. Ignored tooltip-only edits: V4.10 Reinforced Armor 'Reduces the total damage taken from critical strikes' (wiki: tooltip clarification), V4.10 / V4.13 Legendary Guardian, Enchanted Armor, Resistance 'Magic Resist' <-> 'Magic Resistance'. [DD, WP V4.10]
Data = DDragon 4.19.3, identical to 4.20.2 (the repo's s4-final source).

patches.textOnly: V4.10 / V4.13 tooltip rewordings (Reinforced Armor, Legendary Guardian, Enchanted Armor, Resistance); numbers unchanged

changes.text: Preseason 5 (new Summoner's Rift): no mastery change; DDragon 4.19.3 = 4.20.2 = 4.21.5 = ... = 5.9.1 except the V4.13 wording noise already folded into V4.19. [DD, WP V4.20, V4.21, V5.1-V5.9]

Utility overhaul. Meditation and Expanded Mind swap cells: Expanded Mind moves T4 c3 -> T1 c3 (DDragon id 4313), Meditation T1 c3 -> T4 c3 (4343); the prerequisite Strength of Spirit <- T1 c3 now points at Expanded Mind. [DD, WP, RN]
Expanded Mind 2/3.5/5% max mana -> flat 25/50/75 mana. [DD, WP, RN; WM history line says 20/50/75, its own effect line says 25]
Meditation 1/2/3 mana regen per 5 s -> 0.5/1/1.5% missing mana every 5 s. [DD, WP, RN, WM]
Bandit: melee +15 gold on takedown removed; melee now gains 8 gold per champion hit (ranged 3), 5 s per-target cooldown. [DD, WP, RN; WM says 10]
Inspiration 5/10 -> 10/20 experience every 10 s. [DD, WP, RN, WM]
Intelligence item-active CDR 4/7/10% -> 8/14/20% (CDR 2/3.5/5% unchanged). [DD, WP, RN, WM]
Wanderer 5% -> flat 20 out-of-combat movement speed. [DD, WP, RN, WM]

Enchanted Armor T1 -> T5 (4252), 2 -> 4 ranks, 2.5/5% -> 2.5/5/7.5/10% bonus armor and MR. [DD, WP, WM]

Legendary Guardian T5 -> T6 (4262), 4 ranks -> 1, now +3 armor and +3 MR per nearby enemy champion. [DD, WP, WM]
Runic Blessing removed; Adaptive Armor added at T4 (4242): 4% of the higher bonus resist granted as the other. [DD, WP, WM]
Prerequisite links unchanged by cell (Hardiness>Reinforced Armor, Resistance>Evasive, Perseverance>Second Wind ...). Tree still 19 masteries / 34 ranks. [DD]
No calculator-relevant change since V5.12 (V5.13 Oppression 'movement(slows' spacing fix only). Data = DDragon 5.21.1 (the repo's s5-final source). [DD, WP V5.13-V5.21]

patches.textOnly: V5.13 Oppression spacing fix ('movement(slows' -> 'movement (slows'); numbers unchanged

changes.text: Preseason 6: 2014 Offense/Defense/Utility tree removed; Ferocity / Cunning / Resolve keystone trees, 39 masteries in total (13 per tree, 37 ranks per tree), 6 tiers: T1/T3/T5 two 5-rank masteries sharing 5 points, T2/T4 two 1-rank choices, T6 three keystones; 18 points max per tree. [DD, WP, RN]

Keystones: Warlord's Bloodlust (crits heal 15%, +20% AS), Fervor of Battle (10 stacks, 1-8 on-hit), Deathfire Touch (6 + 50% bonus AD + 20% AP over 3 s per DDragon; wiki V5.22 entry says 5), Stormraider's Surge (30% max HP in 2 s -> 35% MS), Thunderlord's Decree (10/level + 20% bonus AD + 10% AP, 30 s cd), Windspeaker's Blessing (+10% heals/shields, +15% resists), Grasp of the Undying (3% max HP), Strength of the Ages, Bond of Stone (4%, doubled near an ally, 8% redirect, stops below 15% HP). [DD, WP, RN, WM]

Layout: each 5-rank row is [mastery, null, mastery] in DDragon (icons on the row edges), matching the repo's airFiveRankLayout 'edge'. Cunning T4 order Bandit / Dangerous Game, Cunning T2 Runic Affinity / Secret Stash. [DD]

Use 5.22.3: 5.22.1 had pre-release Vampirism 0.5-2.5% and Legendary Guardian 0.4-2 per enemy (fixed in 5.22.2). Sorcery (6114) is named 'game_mastery_displayname_6112' in 5.22.1-5.24.1. [DD intra-patch]
Thunderlord's Decree cooldown 30 -> 20 s. [DD, WP]
Bond of Stone base damage reduction 4% -> 2% (x4 = 8% near an ally; redirect 8%). [DD, WP, WM]
Perseverance tooltip threshold 20% -> 25% health (tooltip correction: the real threshold was always 25%). [DD, WP, WM]

Ignored: tooltip rewrites with the same numbers on ~25 masteries (Savagery, Runic Affinity, Secret Stash, Bandit 'attack or spell' -> 'basic attack', Intelligence 'cap +5%' -> 'cap to 45%', Meditation reordering, Recovery, Runic Armor, Insight, Grasp 'deals magic damage', Windspeaker's 'on other allies', Sorcery 'Ability and Spell damage' -> 'Ability damage', trailing periods). [DD]
Assassin added: Cunning T2 third option, 1.5% increased damage while no allied champions are nearby. Cunning T2 = Runic Affinity / Secret Stash / Assassin. [DD, WP]
Precision armor penetration 0.6-3 (+0.06-0.3/level) -> 1-5 (+0.1-0.5/level); magic penetration unchanged. [DD, WP]
Thunderlord's Decree bonus AD ratio 20% -> 30%. [DD, WP]
Windspeaker's Blessing: +15% resists -> +5-22 armor (by level) and half as much MR. [DD, WP]
Feast cooldown 20 -> 25 s. [DD, WP, WM]
Fervor of Battle: stacks only from champions, melee attacks and ability hits give 2 stacks, ability stacks have a 2 s cooldown, stacks last 6 s (was 5). [DD, WP, WM]
Deathfire Touch: 8 + 50% bonus AD + 20% AP over 4 s (was 6 over 3 s); AoE 2 s, DoT 1 s. [DD, WP, WM]
Unyielding 1.2-6% -> 1-5% bonus armor and MR. [DD, WP]
Explorer 12 -> 15 movement speed in brush and river. [DD, WP]
Veteran's Scars 0.8-4% max health -> flat 9/18/27/36/45 health. [DD, WP]
Bond of Stone 3% damage reduction, 6% near an ally, 6% redirect, redirect stops below 5% HP (was 15%). DDragon 5.24-6.2 text omits the threshold; it reappears in 6.3. [DD, WP, WM]
DDragon data fix: Sorcery name restored in 5.24.2. [DD intra-patch]
Precision armor penetration back to 0.6-3 (+0.06-0.3/level). [DD, WP]
Stormraider's Surge window 2 -> 2.5 s, movement speed 35% -> 40%, new 75% slow resistance. [DD, WP]
Warlord's Bloodlust crit heal 15% -> 5-25% by level, attack speed 20% -> 30%. [DD, WP]
Fervor of Battle 1-8 -> 1-14 damage per stack, max stacks 10 -> 8. [DD, WP, WM]
Deathfire Touch ratios 50% bonus AD / 20% AP -> 60% / 25%. [DD, WP, WM]
Strength of the Ages capped heal 100 -> 6% max health, now also on large monster kills. [DD, WP]
Bond of Stone 4% damage reduction, near-ally increase removed, redirect stays 6%. [DD, WP, WM]
Battering Blows / Piercing Thoughts point-split stat bug fixed (no data change). [WP]
Assassin 1.5% -> 2%, now only against champions. [DD, WP]
Thunderlord's Decree cooldown 20 s -> 25-15 s by level; mark window 5 -> 3 s (window not in DDragon text). [DD, WP]
Windspeaker's Blessing tooltip correction: no resist bonus on self (DDragon text already said 'other allies' since 5.23). [WP]
Expose Weakness added: Ferocity T2 third option, damaged enemy champions take 3% more damage from your allies. Ferocity T2 = Double Edged Sword / Feast / Expose Weakness. [DD, WP]
Warlord's Bloodlust rework: crit heal + attack speed replaced by life steal that grows with missing health, up to 20% vs champions, 50% of that vs minions. [DD, WP]

Folded in (not listed): V6.3 DDragon text-only edits - Bond of Stone regains 'not redirected below 5% maximum health' (a V5.24 change), Thunderlord's 'damaging spell against the same enemy champion', Deathfire 'additional', Precision '.06' -> '0.06'. Live V6.3 only fixed a Strength of the Ages heal bug. [DD, WP V6.3]
Warlord's Bloodlust life steal vs minions for ranged champions 50% -> 25%. [DD, WP]
Feast cooldown 25 -> 30 s. [DD, WP, WM]
Grasp of the Undying 3% -> 2.5% max health (ranged halved). [DD, WP]
Secret Stash biscuit 20 health + 10 mana -> 15 health + 15 mana. [DD, WP]
Tooltip-only: Fervor 'Attacking enemy champions' -> 'Damaging enemy champions with an attack'. [DD]
Double Edged Sword melee/ranged split removed: everyone deals 3% more and takes 1.5% more damage. [DD, WP]
Fervor of Battle ability hits 2 -> 1 stack. [DD, WP, WM]
Grasp of the Undying damage 2.5% -> 3% max health, heal 2.5% -> 1.5%. [DD, WP]
Natural Talent per-level only -> base + per-level (0.4-2 + 0.09-0.44/level AD, 0.6-3 + 0.13-0.67/level AP); level-18 totals unchanged. [DD, WP]
Veteran's Scars 9-45 -> 10/20/30/40/50 health. [DD, WP]
No calculator-relevant change since V6.12; V6.15-V6.19 were bug fixes only (Fervor traps, Grasp/Yasuo, Secret Stash refillables, Oppressor). Data = DDragon 6.21.1. [DD 6.12.1 = 6.21.1, WP]

Ferocity T2: Fresh Blood added (first basic attack vs a champion deals 10 + 1/level bonus damage; 6 s cooldown per DDragon, client 7.x and wiki mastery page, Riot notes say 9 s). Double Edged Sword moved T2 -> T4 (DDragon id 6121 -> 6142) and buffed 3%/1.5% -> 5%/2.5%. [DD, WP, RN, WM]

Ferocity T4: Oppressor removed; Battle Trance added (up to 5% increased damage over 5 s in combat with champions); Bounty Hunter 1% -> 1.5% per unique kill. T4 = Bounty Hunter / Double Edged Sword / Battle Trance. [DD, WP, RN, WM]
Fervor of Battle: on-hit damage -> 1-6 bonus AD per stack (by level), 10 stacks, 4 s, basic attacks only (ability stacks removed, undocumented). [DD, WP, WM]

Cunning T4: Greenfather's Gift added (after entering brush, next damaging attack or ability deals 3% current health magic damage, 9 s cd); T4 = Greenfather's Gift / Bandit / Dangerous Game. Precision: armor penetration -> 1.7/3.4/5.1/6.8/8.5 Lethality (magic penetration unchanged). [DD, WP]

Resolve T2: Siegemaster added (+8 armor and MR near an allied tower); T2 = Explorer / Tough Skin / Siegemaster. T4: Fearless added (10% + 2/level bonus armor and MR for 2 s when damaged by a champion, 9 s cd); T4 = Insight / Perseverance / Fearless. [DD, WP]
Resolve T6: Strength of the Ages removed; Courage of the Colossus added (shield 10 + 10/level + 7% max HP per nearby enemy champion for 4 s after hard CC, 30 s cd). [DD, WP]

Layout: every 5-rank row loses its middle null cell (icons move from the row edges to a centred pair; repo airFiveRankLayout 'edge' -> centred); every T2/T4 row now has 3 options; 45 masteries in total (15 per tree, 39 ranks per tree). [DD]
Fervor of Battle stack duration 4 -> 6 s, 1-6 -> 1-8 AD per stack, max stacks 10 -> 8. [DD, WP, WM]
Courage of the Colossus 7% -> 5% max health per nearby enemy, cooldown 30 -> 45-30 s by level; tooltip now lists stun / taunt / snare / knock up. [DD, WP]
Courage of the Colossus base shield 10 + 10/level (once) -> 3-54 by level per nearby enemy champion; duration 4 -> 3 s. [DD, WP, LC]
Battle Trance 5% over 5 s -> 3% over 3 s. [DD, WP, LC]
Bounty Hunter 1.5% -> 1% per unique kill (max 5%). [DD, WP, WM, LC]
Double Edged Sword 5% / 2.5% -> 3% / 1.5%. [DD, WP, LC]
Fearless flat resists 2/level -> 1.5/level. [DD, WP, LC]
Fervor of Battle stack duration 6 -> 8 s. [DD, WP, WM, LC]
Meditation 0.3-1.5% -> 0.25/0.5/0.75/1/1.25% missing mana per 5 s. [DD, WP, LC]
Precision Lethality 1.7-8.5 -> 1.2/2.4/3.6/4.8/6; magic penetration 0.6-3 + 0.06-0.3/level -> 0.3-1.5 + 0.05-0.25/level. [DD, WP, LC]
Warlord's Bloodlust max life steal 20% -> 15%. [DD, WP, LC]

Bond of Stone reworked and renamed Stoneborn Pact (same cell 6263): +5% max health; movement-impairing CC brands enemy champions for 4 s, allies attacking them heal 5 + 2.5% of your max health over 2 s (halved if you are ranged). [DD, WP, LC]
Warlord's Bloodlust rework: moving/attacking charges an Energized attack with 1-50% life steal (by level) and 30% movement speed for 0.75 s. [DD, WP, LC]
Deathfire Touch bonus AD ratio 60% -> 45%. [DD, WP, WM, LC]

Last patch with masteries; V7.22 replaces them with Runes Reforged (DDragon 7.22.1 / 7.23.1 still ship an unchanged mastery.json). [DD, LC, WP]
